GateStatus.description:
Status of a gate issue (SPEC-0001 R5); `draft` is its initial status.

- `draft`: Open: the subject waits for the approval of a person.
- `done`: A person approved the subject on the issue, as recorded in the ledger; terminal.
- `superseded`: Replaced by the gates in `superseded_by`, or its subject was superseded; terminal.

description: A gate issue (SPEC-0001, Gate issue): the tracker issue on which a person approves a brief or a council report.

approved_by.description: Person who approved, as recorded in the ledger; required when `status` is `done`.

id.description: Stable identifier, in the canonical form of the type; assigned by the engine and never reused (SPEC-0001 R2, R14).

issue.description: Tracker number of the issue, once the issue exists.

language.description: Language of the prose, a BCP 47 tag; when absent, the language of the project.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema of the type the document was written against (SPEC-0001 R16).

status.description: Current status (SPEC-0001 R5), not the issue-cycle state of SPEC-0002.

subject.description: The brief or council report submitted for approval.

superseded_by.description: Identifiers of the artifacts of the same type that replace this one, at least one; required when `status` is `superseded`.

items.description: Identifier of a gate issue: `GATE-` and four digits, or five or more without a leading zero, for example `GATE-0001`.

title.description: Outcome or name, in sentence case without a final full stop; 1 to 120 characters (Unicode code points).

title: Gate
